<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Portfolio — [ Your Name ]</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Special+Elite&family=Courier+Prime:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&family=IM+Fell+English:ital@0;1&family=Playfair+Display:ital@1&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   ROOT & RESET
══════════════════════════════════════ */
:root {
  --ink:         #1a0f05;
  --ink-faded:   #3a2a1a;
  --paper:       #f0e6cc;
  --paper-warm:  #e8d9b5;
  --paper-dark:  #d4c49a;
  --paper-deep:  #c4b080;
  --coffee:      #6b4226;
  --coffee-lt:   #9a6840;
  --coffee-dk:   #3e2010;
  --gold:        #c8a84a;
  --red-stamp:   #8b1a1a;
  --wood-dk:     #2a1808;
  --wood-md:     #4a2c10;
  --wood-lt:     #7a5030;
  --metal:       #888070;
  --ribbon:      #111108;
  --shadow:      rgba(15,8,2,0.7);
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

html { font-size: 16px; }

body {
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  background: var(--wood-dk);
  color: var(--ink);
  overflow-x: hidden;
  cursor: none;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   CUSTOM CURSOR
══════════════════════════════════════ */
#cursor-outer {
  position: fixed; width: 28px; height: 28px;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--coffee-lt);
  border-radius: 50%;
  pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999;
  transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
  transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.2s;
  mix-blend-mode: normal;
}
#cursor-inner {
  position: fixed; width: 5px; height: 5px;
  background: var(--gold);
  border-radius: 50%;
  pointer-events: none; z-index: 10000;
  transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
}
body:hover #cursor-outer { border-color: var(--gold); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   TASKBAR / NAVBAR
══════════════════════════════════════ */
#navbar {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 800;
  height: 54px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a0a02 0%, #0f0601 100%);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--wood-md);
  display: flex; align-items: center;
  padding: 0 32px;
  gap: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.8);
}

.nav-logo {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  margin-right: auto;
  text-decoration: none;
}
.nav-logo-img {
  width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--coffee);
  object-fit: cover; object-position: center 5%;
  filter: sepia(0.5) contrast(1.05) brightness(0.9);
}
.nav-logo-name {
  font-family: 'Special Elite', cursive;
  color: var(--paper-warm);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.nav-sep { width: 1px; height: 28px; background: rgba(160,100,40,0.25); margin: 0 4px; }

.nav-btn {
  background: none; border: none;
  color: rgba(240,230,204,0.55);
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 2.5px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 0 18px; height: 54px;
  cursor: pointer;
  position: relative;
  transition: color 0.25s;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.nav-btn::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute;
  bottom: 0; left: 50%; right: 50%;
  height: 2px; background: var(--gold);
  transition: left 0.3s, right 0.3s;
}
.nav-btn:hover { color: var(--paper); }
.nav-btn:hover::after, .nav-btn.active::after { left: 16px; right: 16px; }
.nav-btn.active { color: var(--paper); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   PAGE SYSTEM  — each "page" is full-screen
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.page {
  position: fixed; inset: 54px 0 0 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 1;
  transition: none; /* JS controls transitions */
}
.page.active {
  opacity: 1;
  pointer-events: all;
  z-index: 2;
}

/* Page-turn container */
#page-wrap {
  position: fixed; inset: 54px 0 0 0;
  perspective: 1600px;
  z-index: 100;
  pointer-events: none;
}
#page-flipper {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  transform-origin: left center;
  transform-style: preserve-3d;
  transform: rotateY(0deg);
  pointer-events: none;
}
#page-flipper.flip-forward {
  animation: flipForward 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) forwards;
}
#page-flipper.flip-backward {
  animation: flipBackward 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) forwards;
}
@keyframes flipForward {
  0%   { transform: rotateY(0deg); }
  50%  { transform: rotateY(-90deg); box-shadow: -40px 0 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); }
  100% { transform: rotateY(-180deg); opacity: 0; }
}
@keyframes flipBackward {
  0%   { transform: rotateY(-180deg); opacity: 0; }
  50%  { transform: rotateY(-90deg); opacity: 1; box-shadow: -40px 0 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); }
  100% { transform: rotateY(0deg); }
}

.flip-face {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: var(--paper);
  backface-visibility: hidden;
}
.flip-front { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--paper) 0%, var(--paper-warm) 100%); }
.flip-back  {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--paper-warm) 0%, var(--paper-dark) 100%);
  transform: rotateY(180deg);
}
.flip-lines {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    transparent, transparent 28px,
    rgba(107,66,38,0.07) 28px, rgba(107,66,38,0.07) 29px
  );
}
.flip-grain {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
  opacity: 0.04;
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   PAGE 0 — LANDING (typewriter scene)
══════════════════════════════════════ */
#page-landing {
  background: var(--wood-dk);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Full-bleed typewriter photo background */
.tw-bg-photo {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background-image: var(--tw-bg-url);
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center 30%;
  filter: brightness(0.35) sepia(0.4) contrast(1.1);
  z-index: 0;
}

/* Atmospheric overlay */
.tw-vignette {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%,
    transparent 30%,
    rgba(10,4,0,0.6) 80%,
    rgba(5,2,0,0.92) 100%
  );
}
/* Top shadow for navbar */
.tw-top-shadow {
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 120px; z-index: 2;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(5,2,0,0.8) 0%, transparent 100%);
}

/* Dust particles */
.dust {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden;
}
.dust-p {
  position: absolute;
  width: 2px; height: 2px;
  background: rgba(200,168,74,0.5);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: dustFloat linear infinite;
}
@keyframes dustFloat {
  0%   { transform: translateY(100%) translateX(0) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0; }
  10%  { opacity: 1; }
  90%  { opacity: 0.6; }
  100% { transform: translateY(-80px) translateX(30px) rotate(360deg); opacity: 0; }
}

/* Centre content */
.landing-centre {
  position: relative; z-index: 10;
  text-align: center;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
}

/* Typewriter machine art — built from CSS + reference image */
.tw-machine {
  position: relative;
  width: 500px;
  margin: 0 auto 0;
}

.tw-ref-photo {
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: 6px;
  filter: sepia(0.3) contrast(1.15) brightness(0.85) saturate(0.8);
  box-shadow:
    0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.9),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(160,100,40,0.2),
    inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  display: block;
}

/* Paper emerging from top of machine */
.tw-paper-wrap {
  position: absolute;
  top: -88px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 62%;
  z-index: 5;
}
.tw-paper-sheet {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f7f0dc 0%, #ede0bc 100%);
  width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 -8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 2px 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
}
.tw-paper-sheet::before {
  content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    transparent, transparent 18px,
    rgba(107,66,38,0.09) 18px, rgba(107,66,38,0.09) 19px
  );
}
.tw-paper-stain {
  position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(107,66,38,0.14) 0%, rgba(107,66,38,0.04) 60%, transparent 100%);
}
#tw-typed-text {
  font-family: 'Special Elite', cursive;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: #111;
  line-height: 1.75;
  position: relative; z-index: 2;
  min-height: 70px;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
}
.tw-cursor {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 2px; height: 0.9em;
  background: #111;
  vertical-align: text-bottom;
  margin-left: 1px;
  animation: twBlink 0.75s step-end infinite;
}
@keyframes twBlink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

/* Quote above machine */
.landing-quote-block {
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  max-width: 560px;
}
.landing-quote-text {
  font-family: 'IM Fell English', serif;
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: rgba(240,230,204,0.72);
  line-height: 1.65;
}
.landing-quote-attr {
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: rgba(200,168,74,0.6);
  margin-top: 8px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* Hero text & CTA */
.landing-hero {
  margin-top: 14px;
  text-align: center;
}
.landing-name {
  font-family: 'Special Elite', cursive;
  font-size: 1.9rem;
  color: var(--paper-warm);
  letter-spacing: 7px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  line-height: 1;
}
.landing-role {
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  color: var(--coffee-lt);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-top: 8px;
}

/* CTA arrow — side positioned, handwritten style */
.cta-arrow-wrap {
  position: absolute;
  right: -160px;
  top: 55%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 6px;
  opacity: 0.85;
  animation: ctaFloat 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes ctaFloat {
  0%,100% { transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(0); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-50%) translateX(-6px); }
}
.cta-text {
  font-family: 'IM Fell English', serif;
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 1.0rem;
  color: var(--paper-warm);
  white-space: nowrap;
  transform: rotate(-8deg);
  transform-origin: top left;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.cta-sig {
  font-family: 'IM Fell English', serif;
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  color: var(--gold);
  transform: rotate(-5deg);
  display: inline-block;
  transform-origin: top left;
  margin-left: 10px;
}
/* Curly arrow SVG */
.cta-arrow-svg {
  width: 80px;
  transform: rotate(10deg) scaleX(-1);
  margin-top: -4px;
  margin-left: 20px;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   PAPER PAGE BASE
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.paper-page {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #f5ecd5 0%, #ecddb8 50%, #e6d5a8 100%);
  overflow-y: auto;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
.paper-page::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 5px; }
.paper-page::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--paper-dark); }
.paper-page::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--coffee); border-radius: 3px; }

/* Paper texture overlays */
.paper-lines-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    transparent, transparent 28px,
    rgba(107,66,38,0.07) 28px, rgba(107,66,38,0.07) 29px
  );
}
.paper-grain-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
  opacity: 0.025;
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 300 300' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85' numOctaves='4'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
}

/* Coffee stains */
.cs {
  position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(107,66,38,0.13) 0%, rgba(107,66,38,0.04) 55%, transparent 100%);
}

/* Page inner content */
.page-content {
  position: relative; z-index: 2;
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 50px 60px 80px;
}

/* Section header */
.sec-header {
  display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}
.sec-num {
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--coffee);
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  opacity: 0.6;
}
.sec-title {
  font-family: 'Special Elite', cursive;
  font-size: 1.7rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  line-height: 1;
  flex: 1;
}
.sec-rule {
  flex: 1; height: 1px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--coffee-lt), transparent);
  opacity: 0.35;
  margin-left: 8px;
  align-self: center;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   PAGE 1 — ABOUT
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.about-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 200px;
  gap: 50px;
  align-items: start;
}
.about-body {
  font-family: 'IM Fell English', serif;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--ink-faded);
  line-height: 1.85;
}
.about-body p + p { margin-top: 18px; }
.about-body em {
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--coffee);
}

/* Photo on paper */
.photo-on-paper {
  position: relative;
  transform: rotate(2deg);
  margin-top: 8px;
}
.photo-on-paper img {
  width: 100%; display: block;
  filter: sepia(0.45) contrast(1.08) brightness(0.95);
  border: 6px solid white;
  box-shadow: 4px 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 0 0 1px rgba(107,66,38,0.2);
}
.photo-caption {
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--coffee);
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* Typed effect for about */
.typewritten {
  display: inline;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   PAGE 2 — SKILLS
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.skills-list { list-style: none; }

.skill-row {
  display: flex; align-items: baseline;
  padding: 12px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted rgba(107,66,38,0.2);
  gap: 12px;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateX(-12px);
  transition: opacity 0.4s ease, transform 0.4s ease;
}
.skill-row.vis { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

.skill-bullet {
  font-family: 'Special Elite', cursive;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--coffee);
  width: 16px; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.skill-name-col {
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ink);
  flex: 1;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
.skill-level {
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--coffee-lt);
  font-style: italic;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
/* Typewriter dots indicating level — purely decorative */
.skill-dots {
  display: flex; gap: 4px; align-items: center;
}
.skill-dot {
  width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--coffee);
  background: transparent;
  transition: background 0.3s;
}
.skill-dot.filled { background: var(--coffee); }

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   PAGE 3 — PROJECTS
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.projects-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 24px;
}

.proj-card {
  padding: 22px 24px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(107,66,38,0.25);
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 0.25s, transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}
.proj-card::before {
  content: ''; position: absolute;
  top: 8px; left: 8px; right: -4px; bottom: -4px;
  background: rgba(107,66,38,0.07);
  z-index: -1;
}
.proj-card:hover {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
  transform: translate(-2px,-2px);
  box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 rgba(107,66,38,0.2);
}
.proj-num {
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  color: var(--coffee);
  opacity: 0.6;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.proj-title {
  font-family: 'Special Elite', cursive;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}
.proj-desc {
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: var(--ink-faded);
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.proj-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.proj-tag {
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--coffee);
  border: 1px solid rgba(107,66,38,0.4);
  padding: 2px 9px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   PAGE 4 — CERTIFICATES
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.certs-list { list-style: none; }

.cert-row {
  padding: 20px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(107,66,38,0.15);
  opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px);
  transition: opacity 0.4s, transform 0.4s;
}
.cert-row.vis { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

.cert-top {
  display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.cert-year {
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  color: var(--coffee-lt);
  white-space: nowrap;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}
.cert-title {
  font-family: 'Special Elite', cursive;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: var(--ink);
}
.cert-issuer {
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--coffee-lt);
  font-style: italic;
  padding-left: 56px;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   PAGE 5 — CONTACT
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.contact-letter {
  font-family: 'IM Fell English', serif;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--ink-faded);
  line-height: 1.85;
  margin-bottom: 36px;
}
.contact-details { list-style: none; margin-bottom: 40px; }
.contact-details li {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
  padding: 12px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px dotted rgba(107,66,38,0.2);
  font-family: 'Courier Prime', monospace;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--ink-faded);
}
.contact-details li span.label {
  font-weight: 700; color: var(--coffee);
  width: 90px; flex-shrink: 0;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
}
.contact-signature {
  margin-top: 30px;
}
.sig-closing {
  font-family: 'IM Fell English', serif;
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--ink-faded);
  margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.sig-name {
  font-family: 'IM Fell English', serif;
  font-style: italic;
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  color: var(--coffee);
  transform: rotate(-3deg);
  display: inline-block;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   SOUND VISUALISER
══════════════════════════════════════ */
#sndviz {
  position: fixed; bottom: 20px; right: 20px;
  display: flex; gap: 3px; align-items: flex-end; z-index: 999;
  height: 24px;
}
.sbar {
  width: 3px; background: var(--coffee-lt);
  border-radius: 1.5px; opacity: 0;
  transition: height 0.06s, opacity 0.1s;
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   RESPONSIVE
══════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .tw-machine { width: 300px; }
  .cta-arrow-wrap { right: -10px; top: auto; bottom: -100px; transform: none; }
  .page-content { padding: 30px 22px 60px; }
  .about-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .photo-on-paper { width: 160px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .projects-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .nav-btn { padding: 0 10px; font-size: 0.6rem; }
  .landing-name { font-size: 1.3rem; }
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════
   SLIDE TRANSITION STATE
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.page { transition: opacity 0.05s; }
.page.slide-out-left  { transform: translateX(-100%); opacity: 0; transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), opacity 0.3s; }
.page.slide-in-right  { transform: translateX(100%); transition: none; opacity: 0; }
.page.slide-in-right.arrive  { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), opacity 0.3s; }
.page.slide-out-right { transform: translateX(100%); opacity: 0; transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), opacity 0.3s; }
.page.slide-in-left   { transform: translateX(-100%); transition: none; opacity: 0; }
.page.slide-in-left.arrive   { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; transition: transform 0.65s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), opacity 0.3s; }

</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- Cursor -->
<div id="cursor-outer"></div>
<div id="cursor-inner"></div>

<!-- Sound visualiser -->
<div id="sndviz">
  <div class="sbar" id="s1"></div>
  <div class="sbar" id="s2"></div>
  <div class="sbar" id="s3"></div>
  <div class="sbar" id="s4"></div>
  <div class="sbar" id="s5"></div>
</div>

<!-- ═══════════════════════ NAVBAR ═══════════════════════ -->
<nav id="navbar">
  <a class="nav-logo" href="#" onclick="gotoPage(0);return false;">
    <img class="nav-logo-img" id="navImg" src="" alt="Portrait">
    <span class="nav-logo-name">[ Your Name ]</span>
  </a>
  <div class="nav-sep"></div>
  <button class="nav-btn active" id="nb0" onclick="gotoPage(0)">Home</button>
  <div class="nav-sep"></div>
  <button class="nav-btn" id="nb1" onclick="gotoPage(1)">About</button>
  <div class="nav-sep"></div>
  <button class="nav-btn" id="nb2" onclick="gotoPage(2)">Skills</button>
  <div class="nav-sep"></div>
  <button class="nav-btn" id="nb3" onclick="gotoPage(3)">Projects</button>
  <div class="nav-sep"></div>
  <button class="nav-btn" id="nb4" onclick="gotoPage(4)">Certificates</button>
  <div class="nav-sep"></div>
  <button class="nav-btn" id="nb5" onclick="gotoPage(5)">Contact</button>
</nav>

<!-- ═══════════════════════ PAGE 0 : LANDING ═══════════════════════ -->
<div class="page active" id="page-landing">
  <div class="tw-bg-photo"></div>
  <div class="tw-vignette"></div>
  <div class="tw-top-shadow"></div>
  <div class="dust" id="dust"></div>

  <div class="landing-centre">
    <!-- Quote -->
    <div class="landing-quote-block">
      <div class="landing-quote-text" id="quoteText"></div>
      <div class="landing-quote-attr" id="quoteAttr"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Typewriter + paper -->
    <div class="tw-machine">
      <!-- Paper emerging from top -->
      <div class="tw-paper-wrap">
        <div class="tw-paper-sheet">
          <div class="tw-paper-stain" style="top:4px;right:8px;width:55px;height:55px;"></div>
          <div class="tw-paper-stain" style="bottom:2px;left:6px;width:38px;height:38px;"></div>
          <div id="tw-typed-text"></div><span class="tw-cursor" id="twCursor"></span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <!-- Machine photo -->
      <img class="tw-ref-photo" id="twPhoto" src="" alt="Typewriter">
    </div>

    <!-- Hero -->
    <div class="landing-hero" style="position:relative;">
      <div class="landing-name">[ Your Name ]</div>
      <div class="landing-role">Software Engineer &nbsp;·&nbsp; Builder &nbsp;·&nbsp; Innovator</div>

      <!-- Curly arrow CTA -->
      <div class="cta-arrow-wrap" onclick="gotoPage(1)" style="cursor:pointer;">
        <div class="cta-text">Click to read<br>my portfolio</div>
        <svg class="cta-arrow-svg" viewBox="0 0 100 60" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
          <path d="M 90 5 C 60 5, 10 20, 15 50 C 17 58, 25 58, 30 52"
            stroke="#f0e6cc" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"
            stroke-dasharray="0" />
          <!-- Arrow head -->
          <path d="M 20 45 L 30 52 L 22 58"
            stroke="#f0e6cc" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" fill="none"/>
        </svg>
        <div class="cta-sig">— Your Name</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══════════════════════ PAGE 1 : ABOUT ═══════════════════════ -->
<div class="page" id="page-about">
  <div class="paper-page">
    <div class="paper-lines-overlay"></div>
    <div class="paper-grain-overlay"></div>
    <div class="cs" style="top:60px;right:80px;width:120px;height:120px;"></div>
    <div class="cs" style="bottom:180px;left:40px;width:80px;height:80px;"></div>
    <div class="cs" style="top:300px;right:160px;width:55px;height:55px;"></div>

    <div class="page-content">
      <div class="sec-header">
        <span class="sec-num">§ 01</span>
        <span class="sec-title">About Me</span>
        <div class="sec-rule"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="about-layout">
        <div>
          <div class="about-body" id="about-body">
            <p>I am an engineer who believes that technology, like a well-crafted letter, should communicate with <em>clarity</em> and <em>purpose</em>. Trained in the discipline of systems and software, I have spent the last few years building solutions that sit at the intersection of elegance and function — systems that not only work, but endure.</p>

            <p>My work spans data engineering, cloud architecture, and product development. I am driven by the belief that every line of code is a decision, and every decision compounds over time.</p>

            <p>When I am not engineering systems, I am studying the philosophers who understood long before us that <em>the art is in the constraints</em>.</p>
          </div>

          <!-- Inline letter date -->
          <div style="margin-top:32px;font-family:'Courier Prime',monospace;font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--coffee);font-style:italic;">
            Written on: <span id="letterDate"></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <div class="photo-on-paper">
            <img id="aboutPhoto" src="" alt="[ Your Name ]">
            <div class="photo-caption">[ Your Name ] · Engineer</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══════════════════════ PAGE 2 : SKILLS ═══════════════════════ -->
<div class="page" id="page-skills">
  <div class="paper-page">
    <div class="paper-lines-overlay"></div>
    <div class="paper-grain-overlay"></div>
    <div class="cs" style="top:100px;left:50px;width:90px;height:90px;"></div>
    <div class="cs" style="bottom:200px;right:60px;width:100px;height:100px;"></div>

    <div class="page-content">
      <div class="sec-header">
        <span class="sec-num">§ 02</span>
        <span class="sec-title">Technical Skills</span>
        <div class="sec-rule"></div>
      </div>

      <ul class="skills-list" id="skillsList">
        <!-- Rendered by JS -->
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══════════════════════ PAGE 3 : PROJECTS ═══════════════════════ -->
<div class="page" id="page-projects">
  <div class="paper-page">
    <div class="paper-lines-overlay"></div>
    <div class="paper-grain-overlay"></div>
    <div class="cs" style="top:80px;right:100px;width:110px;height:110px;"></div>
    <div class="cs" style="bottom:150px;left:60px;width:70px;height:70px;"></div>

    <div class="page-content">
      <div class="sec-header">
        <span class="sec-num">§ 03</span>
        <span class="sec-title">Selected Projects</span>
        <div class="sec-rule"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="projects-grid" id="projectsGrid">
        <!-- Rendered by JS -->
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══════════════════════ PAGE 4 : CERTIFICATES ═══════════════════════ -->
<div class="page" id="page-certs">
  <div class="paper-page">
    <div class="paper-lines-overlay"></div>
    <div class="paper-grain-overlay"></div>
    <div class="cs" style="top:60px;right:70px;width:100px;height:100px;"></div>
    <div class="cs" style="bottom:200px;left:50px;width:80px;height:80px;"></div>

    <div class="page-content">
      <div class="sec-header">
        <span class="sec-num">§ 04</span>
        <span class="sec-title">Certifications</span>
        <div class="sec-rule"></div>
      </div>

      <ul class="certs-list" id="certsList">
        <!-- Rendered by JS -->
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══════════════════════ PAGE 5 : CONTACT ═══════════════════════ -->
<div class="page" id="page-contact">
  <div class="paper-page">
    <div class="paper-lines-overlay"></div>
    <div class="paper-grain-overlay"></div>
    <div class="cs" style="top:80px;right:90px;width:90px;height:90px;"></div>
    <div class="cs" style="bottom:160px;left:60px;width:70px;height:70px;"></div>

    <div class="page-content">
      <div class="sec-header">
        <span class="sec-num">§ 05</span>
        <span class="sec-title">Correspondence</span>
        <div class="sec-rule"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="contact-letter">
        <p>Should you wish to discuss a project, an opportunity, or simply to exchange ideas — I would be glad to correspond with you. The details below will reach me reliably.</p>
      </div>

      <ul class="contact-details">
        <li><span class="label">Email</span> your@email.com</li>
        <li><span class="label">LinkedIn</span> linkedin.com/in/yourprofile</li>
        <li><span class="label">GitHub</span> github.com/yourusername</li>
        <li><span class="label">Location</span> [ Your City, Country ]</li>
      </ul>

      <div class="contact-signature">
        <div class="sig-closing">With precision and purpose,</div>
        <div class="sig-name">[ Your Name ]</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Page flip overlay -->
<div id="page-wrap">
  <div id="page-flipper">
    <div class="flip-face flip-front">
      <div class="flip-lines"></div>
      <div class="flip-grain"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="flip-face flip-back">
      <div class="flip-lines"></div>
      <div class="flip-grain"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// ══════════════════════════════════════
// DATA
// ══════════════════════════════════════
const PORTRAIT = "data:image/png;base64,data:image/png;base64,";
const TW_PHOTO  = "data:image/webp;base64,";
const TW_BG     = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";

const SKILLS = [
  { name: "Python / Data Engineering",    level: "Expert",       dots: 5 },
  { name: "JavaScript / React",           level: "Advanced",     dots: 4 },
  { name: "Cloud Architecture (AWS/GCP)", level: "Advanced",     dots: 4 },
  { name: "Machine Learning & MLOps",     level: "Proficient",   dots: 4 },
  { name: "System Design",                level: "Advanced",     dots: 4 },
  { name: "DevOps & CI/CD",               level: "Proficient",   dots: 3 },
  { name: "SQL & Database Design",        level: "Expert",       dots: 5 },
  { name: "Kubernetes & Docker",          level: "Proficient",   dots: 3 },
];

const PROJECTS = [
  { num: "01", title: "Real-Time Data Pipeline",   desc: "A scalable streaming pipeline processing millions of events daily, with sub-second latency and fault-tolerant architecture deployed on AWS.", tags: ["Python","Kafka","AWS","Spark"] },
  { num: "02", title: "Recommendation Engine",     desc: "An intelligent ML system serving personalised recommendations to 50,000+ users in production, reducing churn by 18%.",              tags: ["ML","FastAPI","Docker","Redis"] },
  { num: "03", title: "SaaS Collaboration Platform", desc: "Full-stack multi-tenant platform with real-time editing, role-based access, and a React frontend. Scaled to 10k concurrent users.",  tags: ["React","Node.js","PostgreSQL"] },
  { num: "04", title: "IoT Edge Computing",        desc: "Offline-first processing solution for resource-constrained IoT devices. Reduced cloud bandwidth by 60% while improving response times.", tags: ["C++","MQTT","Embedded","Linux"] },
];

const CERTS = [
  { year: "2024", title: "AWS Solutions Architect — Professional", issuer: "Amazon Web Services" },
  { year: "2024", title: "Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer", issuer: "Google Cloud Platform" },
  { year: "2023", title: "TensorFlow Developer Certificate",        issuer: "Google" },
  { year: "2023", title: "Certified Kubernetes Administrator",      issuer: "Cloud Native Computing Foundation" },
  { year: "2022", title: "Azure Data Engineer Associate",           issuer: "Microsoft Azure" },
];

const QUOTES = [
  { text: '"The engineer has been, and is, a maker of history."',                                    attr: '— James Kip Finch' },
  { text: '"First, solve the problem. Then, write the code."',                                       attr: '— John Johnson' },
  { text: '"Perfection is achieved not when there is nothing more to add, but when there is nothing left to take away."', attr: '— Antoine de Saint-Exupéry' },
  { text: '"Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic."',                 attr: '— Arthur C. Clarke' },
];

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// IMAGES
// ══════════════════════════════════════
document.getElementById("navImg").src     = PORTRAIT;
document.getElementById("aboutPhoto").src = PORTRAIT;
document.getElementById("twPhoto").src    = TW_PHOTO;
document.querySelector(".tw-bg-photo").style.backgroundImage = `url(${TW_BG})`;

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// DATE
// ══════════════════════════════════════
function formatDate(d) {
  const months = ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"];
  return `${d.getDate()} ${months[d.getMonth()]}, ${d.getFullYear()}`;
}
document.getElementById("letterDate").textContent = formatDate(new Date());

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// CURSOR
// ══════════════════════════════════════
const co = document.getElementById("cursor-outer");
const ci = document.getElementById("cursor-inner");
let mx = 0, my = 0, ox = 0, oy = 0;
document.addEventListener("mousemove", e => { mx = e.clientX; my = e.clientY; });
(function animCursor() {
  ox += (mx - ox) * 0.12;
  oy += (my - oy) * 0.12;
  co.style.left = ox + "px"; co.style.top = oy + "px";
  ci.style.left = mx + "px"; ci.style.top  = my + "px";
  requestAnimationFrame(animCursor);
})();

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// AUDIO
// ══════════════════════════════════════
let actx = null;
function getCtx() {
  if (!actx) actx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  return actx;
}
function playClick() {
  try {
    const ctx = getCtx();
    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, ctx.sampleRate * 0.045, ctx.sampleRate);
    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) d[i] = (Math.random()*2-1) * Math.exp(-i / (ctx.sampleRate*0.007));
    const src = ctx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf;
    const g = ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value = 0.12;
    const f = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = "bandpass"; f.frequency.value = 1600; f.Q.value = 0.6;
    src.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
    src.start();
    vizFlash();
  } catch(e) {}
}
function playDing() {
  try {
    const ctx = getCtx();
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator(); const g = ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = "triangle"; osc.frequency.value = 1100;
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, ctx.currentTime);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.5);
    osc.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.start(); osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.5);
  } catch(e) {}
}
function playPageTurn() {
  try {
    const ctx = getCtx();
    const buf = ctx.createBuffer(1, ctx.sampleRate * 0.18, ctx.sampleRate);
    const d = buf.getChannelData(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) {
      const env = i < ctx.sampleRate*0.04 ? i/(ctx.sampleRate*0.04) : Math.exp(-(i-ctx.sampleRate*0.04)/(ctx.sampleRate*0.05));
      d[i] = (Math.random()*2-1) * env * 0.4;
    }
    const src = ctx.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf;
    const g = ctx.createGain(); g.gain.value = 0.25;
    const f = ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = "highpass"; f.frequency.value = 800;
    src.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(ctx.destination);
    src.start();
  } catch(e) {}
}

// Sound viz
function vizFlash() {
  const bars = document.querySelectorAll(".sbar");
  bars.forEach(b => {
    b.style.height = (5 + Math.random()*16) + "px";
    b.style.opacity = "0.9";
  });
  setTimeout(() => bars.forEach(b => { b.style.opacity = "0"; }), 110);
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// PARTICLES
// ══════════════════════════════════════
const dustEl = document.getElementById("dust");
for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
  const p = document.createElement("div");
  p.className = "dust-p";
  p.style.cssText = `left:${Math.random()*100}vw; animation-duration:${10+Math.random()*14}s; animation-delay:${Math.random()*10}s; width:${1+Math.random()*2.5}px; height:${1+Math.random()*2.5}px;`;
  dustEl.appendChild(p);
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// QUOTE
// ══════════════════════════════════════
const q = QUOTES[Math.floor(Math.random() * QUOTES.length)];
document.getElementById("quoteText").textContent = q.text;
document.getElementById("quoteAttr").textContent = q.attr;

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// LANDING TYPEWRITER
// ══════════════════════════════════════
const landingLines = ["[ Your Name ]", "", "Software Engineer", "", "> Building bridges", "  between idea", "  and reality."];
const twEl = document.getElementById("tw-typed-text");
let lStr = "", lChar = 0;
const lFull = landingLines.join("\n");

function typeLanding() {
  if (lChar < lFull.length) {
    const ch = lFull[lChar];
    if (ch === "\n") lStr += "\n";
    else lStr += ch;
    twEl.textContent = lStr;
    lChar++;
    if (ch !== "\n" && ch !== " ") playClick();
    const delay = ch === "\n" ? 320 : (55 + Math.random()*70);
    setTimeout(typeLanding, delay);
  } else {
    playDing();
    document.getElementById("twCursor").style.display = "none";
  }
}
setTimeout(typeLanding, 1200);

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// RENDER SKILLS
// ══════════════════════════════════════
const sl = document.getElementById("skillsList");
SKILLS.forEach((s, i) => {
  const li = document.createElement("li");
  li.className = "skill-row";
  li.style.transitionDelay = (i * 0.07) + "s";
  const dotsHtml = Array.from({length:5}, (_,d) =>
    `<div class="skill-dot ${d < s.dots ? 'filled' : ''} "></div>`
  ).join("");
  li.innerHTML = `
    <span class="skill-bullet">✦</span>
    <span class="skill-name-col">${s.name}</span>
    <div class="skill-dots">${dotsHtml}</div>
    <span class="skill-level">${s.level}</span>
  `;
  sl.appendChild(li);
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// RENDER PROJECTS
// ══════════════════════════════════════
const pg = document.getElementById("projectsGrid");
PROJECTS.forEach(p => {
  const card = document.createElement("div");
  card.className = "proj-card";
  card.innerHTML = `
    <div class="proj-num"># ${p.num}</div>
    <div class="proj-title">${p.title}</div>
    <div class="proj-desc">${p.desc}</div>
    <div class="proj-tags">${p.tags.map(t=>`<span class="proj-tag">${t}</span>`).join("")}</div>
  `;
  pg.appendChild(card);
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// RENDER CERTS
// ══════════════════════════════════════
const cl2 = document.getElementById("certsList");
CERTS.forEach((c, i) => {
  const li = document.createElement("li");
  li.className = "cert-row";
  li.style.transitionDelay = (i * 0.09) + "s";
  li.innerHTML = `
    <div class="cert-top">
      <span class="cert-year">${c.year}</span>
      <span class="cert-title">${c.title}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="cert-issuer">${c.issuer}</div>
  `;
  cl2.appendChild(li);
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════
// PAGE NAVIGATION WITH PAGE-TURN
// ══════════════════════════════════════
const PAGES = ["page-landing","page-about","page-skills","page-projects","page-certs","page-contact"];
let currentPage = 0;
let isTransitioning = false;

function updateNavBtns(idx) {
  for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) {
    const btn = document.getElementById("nb" + i);
    if (btn) btn.classList.toggle("active", i === idx);
  }
}

function gotoPage(targetIdx) {
  if (isTransitioning || targetIdx === currentPage) return;
  isTransitioning = true;
  const forward = targetIdx > currentPage;
  const fromEl = document.getElementById(PAGES[currentPage]);
  const toEl   = document.getElementById(PAGES[targetIdx]);

  // Play sound
  playPageTurn();
  updateNavBtns(targetIdx);

  // Animate page flip
  const flipper = document.getElementById("page-flipper");
  flipper.className = "";
  void flipper.offsetWidth;

  // Set up outgoing and incoming pages
  fromEl.classList.remove("active");

  // Quick stagger so flip overlay covers transition
  setTimeout(() => {
    toEl.style.opacity = "0";
    toEl.style.transform = "none";
    toEl.classList.add("active");
  }, 50);

  flipper.classList.add(forward ? "flip-forward" : "flip-backward");

  // Mid-flip reveal
  setTimeout(() => {
    fromEl.classList.remove("active");
    toEl.style.opacity = "1";
    currentPage = targetIdx;
    triggerPageAnimations(targetIdx);
  }, 350);

  setTimeout(() => {
    flipper.className = "";
    isTransitioning = false;
  }, 720);
}

function triggerPageAnimations(idx) {
  if (idx === 2) {
    // Skills
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.querySelectorAll(".skill-row").forEach(r => r.classList.add("vis"));
    }, 100);
  }
  if (idx === 4) {
    // Certs
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.querySelectorAll(".cert-row").forEach(r => r.classList.add("vis"));
    }, 100);
  }
}

// Keyboard navigation
document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "PageDown") gotoPage(Math.min(currentPage+1, 5));
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft"  || e.key === "PageUp")   gotoPage(Math.max(currentPage-1, 0));
});

// Initial state
updateNavBtns(0);
document.getElementById("page-landing").classList.add("active");
</script>
</body>
</html>
